map.Cgk = min(USL-mean, mean-LSL)/(3*sigma_m: Cgk = min(USL-mean, mean-LSL)/(3*sigma_measure). Example: with the mean off center by 0.002, Cgk is slightly lower than Cg.
map.Cgk=min(8−5.5, 5.5−2)/(3×0.25)=2.5/0.75=: Cgk = min(8-5.5, 5.5-2)/(3 x 0.25) = 2.5/0.75 = 3.333. The mean 5.5 sits exactly in the center; once it shifts, Cgk falls noticeably below Cg.
